name: SQLite
label: SQLite — query and write a database file
description: Run SQL on a SQLite database file. Handler: SqlDatabaseNode with the SQLite JDBC driver (sqlite-jdbc). The database arrives as a file value (max 8 MiB) or starts empty; execute and insert return the updated database on output file, query never changes it. Values bind as ? parameters; ATTACH and extension loading are disabled. Docs: https://www.sqlite.org/lang.html
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One SQL call. Non-blank fields override the node configuration. Wire the database file from an upstream node. Example: {"operation":"query","query":"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?","parameters":[42],"database":<file>}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: query | execute | insert.

schema.label: database
schema.description: SQLite database file (path, ContentBlock or $fileRef). Overrides the config Database File. Blank starts a new database.

schema.label: query
schema.description: SQL for query/execute with ? placeholders. Alias: sql.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Positional values for the ? placeholders. Alias: params.

schema.label: rows
schema.description: Array of column → value objects for insert.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', operation, rows?, columns?, row_count?, truncated?, affected_rows?, file?, data:{value}}. file is the updated SQLite database after execute or insert. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, REQUEST_FAILED) with data {sql_state, vendor_code} for SQL errors.

schema.label: rows
schema.description: Result rows as column → value objects (query, or execute with a result set). Binary values are base64; LOBs are capped at 1 MiB.

schema.label: columns
schema.description: Column labels in result order (insert: the inserted columns).

schema.label: truncated
schema.description: true when max_rows cut the result set.

schema.label: affected_rows
schema.description: Rows changed by execute or insert.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Updated database (application/vnd.sqlite3, max 8 MiB) after execute or insert. Absent for query. Wire it to a storage node to keep the changes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: data.value = rows for queries, affected_rows otherwise. Never includes secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: What to run. EXACT: query (SELECT, returns rows) | execute (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL or a call; returns affected_rows, plus rows when the statement returns a result set) | insert (batch-insert input rows into one table in one transaction). Input operation overrides this when non-blank.

configurationParameters.label: Database File
configurationParameters.description: SQLite database file (path, ContentBlock or $fileRef from an upstream node), max 8 MiB. Input database overrides this. Blank starts a new empty database. execute and insert return the updated database on output file; query never changes it.

configurationParameters.label: SQL
configurationParameters.description: SQL statement for query and execute. Purpose: one statement; use ? placeholders for values and put them in parameters — never concatenate input into SQL. Example: SELECT id, total FROM "orders" WHERE customer_id = ? AND total > ?.

configurationParameters.label: Parameters
configurationParameters.description: Positional values for the ? placeholders, in order. Accepted: JSON array of strings, numbers, booleans or null; objects/arrays are sent as JSON text. Example: [42, 100.5].

configurationParameters.label: Max Rows
configurationParameters.description: Row cap for returned result sets. Purpose: bound memory and output size. Default 1000, max 10000. truncated=true when more rows existed.

configurationParameters.label: Table
configurationParameters.description: Target table for insert: table, schema.table or database.schema.table. Accepted: identifiers [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$#]*; each part is quoted. Example: 'sales.orders'.

configurationParameters.label: Rows
configurationParameters.description: Rows for insert. Accepted: JSON array of objects (column → value), up to 10000. Columns are the union of all keys; a missing key inserts NULL. All rows commit together or roll back together. Example: [{"id":1,"total":9.5}].

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Statement timeout (and lock wait for SQLite). Default 30, max 300.
